sections.en: 3 Ἰαννουάριος ('January') the codex has, as also below. 6 τὸ μηναῖον ('the monthly') the codex has. 19 Perhaps read τῇ νυκτί ('in the night'). 19-20 βασιλεῖς περὶ αὐτῇ διαφθείρει ('kings concerning her destroys') the codex has, βασιλεὺς περὶ αὐτὴν διαφθαρήσεται ('a king concerning her will be destroyed') we have written. 23 ἀπρίλλιος ('April') the codex has. 24 σίτος ('wheat') the codex has. 26 ἐκλείψει ('will eclipse') here and below, l. 32; ἐκλείψῃ ('may eclipse') we have written. 28 καί ('and') we have enclosed in brackets. 29 τὸν κόσμον ('the world') the codex has, we τοῦ κόσμου ('of the world'). 31 Should one read λοιμός ('plague')? 32 λιμών ('famine') the codex has, λιμόν ('famine') we have written. Or λοιμόν ('plague')?

summary.headline: Monthly Brontologion Omens
summary.text: Interpretation of the monthly brontologion, giving omens for January through May from thunder, earthquakes, eclipses, blood-red lunar appearances, falling stars, fog, and sky sounds, including predictions of grain, war, famine, destruction, and political upheaval. The apparatus cites a related excerpt of Melampus and records readings from the codex.
